patronOf.en-US: The Most Holy Body and Blood of Christ
patronOf.pt-BR: Santíssimo Corpo e Sangue de Cristo

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me and I in him, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Quem come a minha carne e bebe o meu sangue, permanece em mim e eu nele, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: The figures are small and secondary: the priest, about fifty, a lean, LONG face with a high forehead and a straight nose, clean-shaven, short grey hair, seen in profile with eyes on the Host; the servers, two boys of about ten, one round-faced and dark, one freckled and fair; the flower girl, about seven, dark braids; the kneeling mother with a broad, warm face under a light scarf; the old man with a narrow, bony face and white stubble.
meta.basis: The Eucharistic procession with the monstrance under a canopy and a carpet of petals is the feast's own public act since the fourteenth century (the flower carpets of Brazil and Italy are still laid). No principal face.
